source_name: НБУ — Нормативна база / Legislation (bank.gov.ua legislation section)
why_relevant: Primary legal publication venue of the NBU: under Ukrainian law the first placement of an NBU normative act on the official NBU website counts as official publication, so this section is the origin node for every binding постанова Правління, положення, інструкція and its effective date.

source_name: НБУ — Регуляторна діяльність / Regulatory activity (draft acts, public consultation)
why_relevant: Publishes проєкти постанов Правління put out for громадське обговорення with comment deadlines — the earliest legally meaningful warning of an upcoming binding rule and its transition period.

source_name: НБУ — Повідомлення про початок/зупинення роботи над проєктами НПА (regulatory planning)
why_relevant: Forward-looking pipeline notice: the NBU announces which normative acts it has started or paused drafting, giving 3-12 months of lead time before a binding deadline exists.

source_name: Законодавство України (Верховна Рада) — publisher filter "Постанова Національного банку України"
why_relevant: State legal database mirror of NBU board resolutions — fetched successfully and reports ~4,176 NBU resolution documents from 1991 to 2026, with consolidated (amended) texts, status flags (чинний / втратив чинність) and year filters. This is the practical fallback when bank.gov.ua blocks automated access.

source_name: НБУ — Усі новини / All news (bank.gov.ua news feed)
why_relevant: The NBU announces each adopted resolution, its purpose and its effective/transition dates in a news item, usually the same day — the fastest structured signal that a new binding act exists, and it links to the act itself.

source_name: НБУ — draft resolutions published as PDFs under /admin_uploads
why_relevant: Draft and final resolution texts are served as static PDFs under predictable /admin_uploads/article/ and /admin_uploads/law/ paths; these static assets are often reachable when the HTML pages are WAF-blocked, and contain the operative 'ця постанова набирає чинності з ...' clause.

source_name: Офіційний вісник України (Ministry of Justice official gazette)
why_relevant: One of the statutory official publication venues for NBU normative acts (alongside Урядовий кур'єр, Голос України and the NBU website). The publication date in ОВУ fixes the legal entry-into-force date when the act does not name a later one.

source_name: LIGA:ZAKON — IPS legal database (NBU resolutions, PB* document ids)
why_relevant: Commercial Ukrainian legal information system carrying consolidated NBU resolution texts with editorial notes on effective dates and amendment chains; often faster and better cross-referenced than the state mirror, and surfaces which acts amend which.

source_name: cis-legislation.com — English translations of NBU board resolutions
why_relevant: Provides English renderings of core NBU acts (e.g. the Instruction on regulation of banks' activities, financial monitoring regulation, licensing of financial service providers) — useful for analyst comprehension where the NBU has published no official English version.

source_name: НАБУ — Незалежна/Національна асоціація банків України
why_relevant: Banking industry association that formally comments on NBU draft resolutions and publishes its outgoing letters (вихідні листи) and thematic pages on economic standards and banking groups — reveals which deadlines the industry is contesting and where transition periods get extended.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА — Українська міжбанківська асоціація членів платіжних систем
why_relevant: Payments-side counterpart to НАБУ: sits on the NBU Public Council on payments, signed a memorandum with the NBU on compliance reporting under the Law on Payment Services, drafts PSD3-based amendments, and publicly lobbies on deadlines (e.g. interchange reduction timing). Best early indicator of payment-sector regulatory deadlines and pushback.

source_name: НБУ Open Data portal + REST API (bank.gov.ua open data)
why_relevant: Machine-readable NBU datasets and a documented REST API (XML/JSON). While mainly statistical/reference (bank directory, payment systems registry, ID codes), it is the sanctioned automated channel into NBU data and the registry endpoints tell you which entities a new prudential rule binds.

source_name: data.gov.ua — National Bank of Ukraine as data publisher
why_relevant: State open-data catalogue page enumerating every dataset the NBU is legally obliged to publish — a pointer that reveals NBU data assets not linked from the main site, including registry sets tied to licensing and supervision obligations.

source_name: old.bank.gov.ua — NBU legacy website archive
why_relevant: Legacy NBU CMS still serving historical articles and act listings that were not migrated; valuable for reconstructing pre-2019 resolution history and for retrieving documents 404-ing on the modern site.

source_name: ВУЕ (Велика українська енциклопедія) — «Акти Національного банку України нормативно-правові»
why_relevant: State encyclopaedia entry defining the taxonomy of NBU acts (постанови, положення, інструкції), their binding force and the statutory publication/effective-date rules — the authoritative glossary for building the classification schema of this cell.

source_name: KPMG Ukraine / Big Four regulatory alerts (uk)
why_relevant: Professional-services alerts translate a new NBU resolution into the concrete compliance obligation and the date by which banks/payment providers must comply — a useful interpretation layer and a redundancy signal that a resolution was adopted.

source_name: sud.ua — legal-sector news on NBU draft regulations
why_relevant: Ukrainian legal news outlet that reports NBU draft resolutions (e.g. changes to the banking-secrecy disclosure rules) while they are still in consultation, often summarising the substantive change faster than the official notice is parsed.

source_name: finance.ua / finclub.net — financial media tracking NBU regulatory moves
why_relevant: Ukrainian financial media report NBU consultations with the comment deadline stated explicitly (e.g. draft amendments to the account opening/closing Instruction, comments accepted to 10 Aug 2026) and cover industry pushback on effective dates.

source_name: НБУ Стратегія / strategy and supervisory methodology PDFs
why_relevant: The NBU strategy document sets the multi-year direction (EU acquis alignment, Basel implementation) from which future prudential resolutions and their transition timetables derive — context for anticipating deadlines rather than recording them.

source_name: zakon.rada.gov.ua — NBU letters/decisions series (v-prefixed ids, non-postanova acts)
why_relevant: Beyond постанови, the NBU issues рішення, листи and Public Council decisions that are also mirrored on the state portal under v-prefixed identifiers; several carry operational deadlines and clarify how a resolution is to be applied.

source_name: НБУ — новини з тегом "обговорення" (drafts_discussion) / NBU news tagged drafts_discussion
why_relevant: This tag is the de-facto NBU public-consultation feed. Every launch of a громадське обговорення is announced as a news item carrying the tag 'drafts_discussion' (displayed as 'обговорення'), with the draft resolution, the regulatory impact analysis, the comparison table and the closing date for comments. Confirmed on a live item (26.08.2026 cash-handling Instruction draft, comments due 04.09.2026).

source_name: NBU news tagged drafts_discussion — English mirror
why_relevant: English-language mirror of the consultation announcements. Coverage is partial (fewer items returned than the Ukrainian list), so it is a convenience layer, not a substitute — but it gives official English terminology for draft titles and deadlines.

source_name: НБУ — Нормотворча діяльність (regulatory-activity hub)
why_relevant: The master hub for NBU rule-making. It is the node that links out to the consultation tag feed, the rule-making planning notices, the regulatory-acts filter of the legislation search, and the non-bank market regulation page. Best single entry point for a scout to re-discover moved sections.

source_name: НБУ — Повідомлення про початок або зупинення/відкладення роботи над проєктами НПА
why_relevant: Earliest signal in the whole chain: the NBU announces here that it has STARTED (or paused/postponed) work on a draft normative act — months before any draft text is published for comment. For a market-intelligence lead-time play this beats the consultation feed itself.

source_name: НБУ — репозиторій документів обговорення (/admin_uploads/article/ proekt_ / analiz_ / tabl_proekt_)
why_relevant: The actual consultation artefacts live at a highly predictable path with date-stamped filenames: proekt_YYYY-MM-DD.pdf/.docx (draft resolution), analiz_YYYY-MM-DD.pdf (аналіз регуляторного впливу / RIA), tabl_proekt_YYYY-MM-DD.pdf/.docx (порівняльна таблиця). This is where the substantive text and the regulator's own cost/impact reasoning sit — the highest-value payload of the whole cell.

source_name: НБУ — форма надання зауважень та пропозицій (shablon_propozyciy.xlsx)
why_relevant: The mandatory comment-submission template linked from every consultation notice. It documents the formal channel and the metadata the NBU expects from respondents — useful for understanding who can respond and how, and for a client that may want to file comments.

source_name: НБУ — Розширений пошук законодавства, тип 11 "План підготовки проєктів регуляторних актів"
why_relevant: The NBU's statutory forward plan of regulatory acts it intends to prepare. A structured, filterable document type in the legislation search (verified: the type selector exposes value 11 = 'План підготовки проєктів регуляторних актів'). Gives a 6–12 month horizon of what will enter consultation.

source_name: НБУ — Розширений пошук, тип 13 "Здійснення регуляторної діяльності"
why_relevant: Dedicated document class for the NBU's regulatory-activity paperwork (procedure acts, notices, RIA-related instruments). Complements the consultation feed with the formal/legal layer of the same process.
